integrity: The included standard-library Python verifier exhaustively checks all 2^20 subsets and the pure shelling criterion. Self-review only; independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: Only the n=4 simplicial complex is treated. No general-n shellability, vertex-decomposability, or positive-characteristic F-rationality claim is made for the nested Hilbert scheme itself.
title: A shelling certificate for a nested Hilbert-scheme degeneration
